summary.intent: Execute Phase 24 (Bug Fixes & Test Infrastructure) for cipher-box, including parallel plan execution, code review/simplification, PR creation, CI fixes, and reviewer comment resolution.
summary.outcome: Phase 24 was fully executed and merged to main with 3 plans completed (bin IPNS 404 fix, SDK load tests, recovery page cleanup). A secondary PR (#364) was opened to fix the recovery E2E test in CI by routing IPNS resolution through the CipherBox API instead of Kubo's gateway.

repo: IPNS records are published via mock-ipns-routing (port 3001) in CI, not Kubo's DHT — so Kubo's gateway (8080) cannot resolve IPNS names published during tests; only the CipherBox API (localhost:3000) can resolve them via DB cache

recovery.html resolveIpns fallback chain: (1) /ipns/ path on IPFS gateway → (2) /routing/v1/ipns/ delegated routing with 3 retries → (3) localhost:3000/ipns/resolve CipherBox API → (4) Kubo /api/v0/name/resolve POST
Kubo running in CI Docker containers has no CORS headers configured by default — browser-based tests cannot make cross-origin requests to Kubo API (5001) or gateway (8080) without explicit config
The web E2E workflow was missing SDK_E2E_SECRET env var for the test runner process — the API had TEST_LOGIN_SECRET but createTestAccount from the SDK harness reads SDK_E2E_SECRET separately
publishWithVerify was re-publishing on every verification retry — the correct behavior is publish once, then retry only the verification check
computeIpHash() exists in apps/web/src/lib/device/info.ts but useAuth.ts was inlining 7 lines of SHA-256 logic
DeviceRegistry now has v1/v2 schema versioning — v1 registries are read leniently but new registries are created as v2 with SHA-256 ipHash
loadBin auto-repair behavior changes sequenceNumber from 0 to 1 for a fresh account — SDK E2E and integration tests needed updating to expect sequenceNumber: 1
Web app type errors (deriveVaultKeyIpnsKeypair, deriveByoConfigIpnsKeypair) were caused by stale package builds, not code issues — pnpm build on crypto and api-client packages resolved them

code.finding: publishWithVerify now publishes once then retries only verification — previously re-published on every retry attempt
validateRegistryShape() extracted to deduplicate v1/v2 validation; only auto-heals empty ipHash strings, rejects other malformed values
cid/pinSize must be declared above the try block (not inside) so the finally block can access them — TypeScript scopes let declarations to their enclosing block

IPFS_GATEWAY defaults to localhost:8080, IPNS_GATEWAY defaults to API_URL (localhost:3000) — separating them is necessary because CI's mock routing only makes IPNS resolvable via the CipherBox API, not Kubo's gateway
Removed vestigial base64 fallback for private key input — v2 recovery only uses 64-character hex keys; the base64 path was dead code from removed export file mode
Web E2E job needs both TEST_LOGIN_SECRET (for the API process) and SDK_E2E_SECRET (for the test runner process) — they must match but are read by different parts of the stack

workflow: GSD wave-based parallel execution with 3 simultaneous subagents completed in ~10min; plan 24-01 (most complex with registry schema changes) was the bottleneck at 10min vs 4-7min for others
classifyHandoffIfNeeded runtime bug in Claude Code: agent may report 'failed' despite completing all work — spot-check SUMMARY.md + git commits to determine true status

TypeScript cross-function narrowing doesn't propagate — validateRegistryShape() narrowing obj.devices inside the function doesn't narrow the caller; requires explicit cast (as unknown[]) after the call
Mock-ipns-routing is preferred over someguy in CI for determinism and speed — the only gap is recovery.html which bypasses the API, fixable by routing its IPNS calls through the API
Kubo CORS config in CI: ipfs config --json API.HTTPHeaders.Access-Control-Allow-Origin '["*"]' and Gateway equivalent, then ipfs restart — must be done after the container is healthy

friction: recovery.html E2E test required 3 separate PRs and multiple CI runs to fix: (1) missing SDK_E2E_SECRET, (2) Kubo CORS headers, (3) IPNS resolution routing through API instead of Kubo gateway
GitHub API was repeatedly timing out during log fetching, requiring manual polling and delays
Background task exit code 128 false alarms — push had already succeeded via a later explicit git push, but background tasks reported failure
Docker host IP changed (192.168.133.114 → 192.168.133.12) after network reset, requiring .env update — no config abstraction for this
TypeScript stale package builds (.d.ts files) caused 6 apparent type errors that were not real code bugs — had to build dependent packages to resolve
byo-file-workload.ts cid/pinSize hoisting fix was complicated by Copilot suggesting string|undefined while usage sites still needed non-null assertions, making the improvement cosmetic
Planning file conflicts from concurrent phase 24 and 25 branches required manual resolution of ROADMAP, STATE, PROJECT, and REQUIREMENTS markdown files
open_items: recovery.html E2E test still failing in CI as of end of transcript — PR #364 with IPNS_GATEWAY defaulting to API_URL is open but not yet merged/verified
Local recovery.html testing requires Kubo CORS configuration (ipfs config commands on Docker host) — not documented anywhere and requires manual setup each time network resets
recovery.html IPFS content fetch still goes through Kubo gateway (8080) which will CORS-fail in local browser testing unless Kubo CORS is configured on the Docker host
2 SDK integration tests always fail locally (ECONNREFUSED) because they require the live API — these are not skipped, just quietly fail every run
byo-file-workload.ts has pre-existing errors in CI that were not addressed — only the cid/pinSize hoisting was fixed
No proxy endpoint in the CipherBox API for IPFS content (/ipfs/cat/:cid) — adding one would eliminate the Kubo CORS dependency for browser-based recovery testing
